methodology: Each classification was reconstructed from the canonical case trace selected by the frozen Mini-50 completion result.
Proposed actions, calls that entered Tool execution, and policy-blocked actions are counted separately.
Raw traces remain local-only; run id, trace SHA-256, event count, and compact excerpts provide provenance without publishing prompts or machine paths.
A missing successful write means no replace_text, write_file, or create_file action completed before the terminal state.

summary.finding: The five failure-fuse cases followed different environment, command-policy, path-policy, and recovery chains. The timeout case was an in-flight model request overrun, not a search or context-growth loop.

future_not_implemented.in_flight_model_deadline: Run deadline -> propagate remaining budget into ModelPort/provider request -> bounded transport timeout -> cancellation and timeout attribution -> deterministic terminal state
